run_versiongenerate: run versiongenerate.py with input_dir and output_dir to extract version from configure.ac and write Version.h
build_version_header: build a Version.h header file with GTEST_VERSIONINFO_SHORT and GTEST_VERSIONINFO_LONG defines from configure.ac
extract_version_from_configure_ac: extract the major, minor, and fix version numbers from the AC_INIT macro in configure.ac using regex
generate_info_plist_version: generate version defines for substitution in the gtest.framework Info.plist file from configure.ac
parse_ac_init_version: parse the AC_INIT macro in configure.ac to extract a three-part version string in brackets
